source_read: Squire's Garden Centres café bar menus, Autumn/Winter 2026: the 17 café bar pages listed in the menu of https://www.squiresgardencentres.co.uk/ (cafe_bars/badshot-lea-2 ... wokingham-cafe-bar), each linking its breakfast, lunch, drinks and Little Gardener's PDFs on the same site; 15 distinct PDFs (14 different files; combined sha256 c6f64c2bbd64f77c9ea53e923685f1b9f68cb75dea96ced648f10b0cba6bb07f), InDesign exports created 28 September to 8 October 2026 with a text layer; robots.txt of www.squiresgardencentres.co.uk disallows only admin, search and account paths
not_verifiable: no allergen information is published online (the menus print only gf/gfa/v/vg/vga codes and ask diners to speak to staff); which centre serves a dish beyond the PDFs its own page links
notes: Extraction reads word boxes and type sizes (pdftotext -bbox). Second read, by a different method: the plain layout text of every PDF (pdftotext -layout) searched with simple regular expressions, no type sizes: for each of the 169 published items some menu line prints its figure as 'NNNkcal' right after the words of its name (or, for a large size, after the regular figure of the drink named before it, 'Latte 139kcal | 208kcal'; for the four-column children's menu, within the few lines above, since the layout text interleaves its columns): 169 of 169 found. Every figure on every PDF is accounted for: the layout text holds the same number of 'NNNkcal' figures per PDF as the script used or left out (e.g. Bras-Plus lunch 69 = 65 items + 4 'Swap salad for' figures; drinks 52; Little Gardener's 42 / 39 / 38), the daily-intake line '2000kcal' excepted. Looked at by eye on rendered pages: the drinks menu prints REGULAR and LARGE price columns with 'Espresso 1kcal | 2kcal £2.60 £3.20' (so the second figure is the large size, also for Plain hot chocolate in the same columns), and the children's menu is four printed columns with 'NEW LUXURY HOT / CHOCOLATE 204kcal' over two lines. The menus agree with each other: no dish name is printed with different calories on different menus, and every published dish is on the menus of at least two café bars (the sourdough pizzas and children's mini pizzas only at Badshot Lea and Wokingham). Left out: the afternoon tea menu (figures for the parts of one set), the 'Swap salad for chips 192kcal or sweet potato fries 252kcal' lines (the figure could be the side or the difference), and the wine, cider and beer list (no figures printed; alcohol is never added). Vegetarian tags come from the menus' own v / vg codes (at two or more café bars); gfa/vga ('available') are not turned into tags.
